official: 杉並区立自転車駐車場条例の一部を改正する条例

sources.label: 令和8年第2回定例会 議案・議決結果の一覧

name: 西永福北に区立自転車駐車場を設置
summary: 区は以前、西永福北自転車駐車場を廃止しました。今回、旧駐車場の敷地の一部を借り、約30台を収容する区立駐車場として整備します。その名称と所在地を条例に加え、施行日は規則で定めます。
changes: 杉並区立西永福北自転車駐車場を条例に加える
所在地を杉並区永福3丁目55番3号と定める
who: 西永福北自転車駐車場を利用する人
why: 区立自転車駐車場を1か所設けるにあたり、名称と所在地を定める必要があるためと、区は説明しています。

en.name: Establishes a Suginami City bicycle parking facility in Nishi-Eifuku Kita
en.official: Ordinance Partially Amending the Suginami City Bicycle Parking Facility Ordinance
en.summary: The ward previously abolished the Nishi-Eifuku Kita Bicycle Parking Facility. This time, it will rent part of the former facility’s site and develop it as a ward-run bicycle parking facility with space for about 30 bicycles. The ward will add its name and location to the ordinance, and the effective date will be set by rules.
changes: Add the Suginami City Nishi-Eifuku Kita Bicycle Parking Facility to the ordinance
Set its location as 3-55-3 Eifuku, Suginami City
who: People who use the Nishi-Eifuku Kita Bicycle Parking Facility
en.why: The ward says it is necessary to set a name and location when establishing one ward-run bicycle parking facility.
